request: Let the cache middleware store responses with status 404 as well as successful ones, so repeated misses do not keep hitting the backend.

source.request: Let the cache middleware store responses with status 404 as well as successful ones, so repeated misses do not keep hitting the backend.
source.settled: The cache middleware does not cache responses with status 400 or greater.
source.why: Caching 404 responses would reverse the exclusion of error responses.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
